# reports/

This folder is the output location for **Personalized AI Opportunity Reports** (the Chaos Phase / free audit deliverables).

## Generated by
- The web forms (via the owner manually or via the desktop monitor tool)
- The `GrokFirebaseReportMonitor` Windows desktop tray app (in `../../tools/GrokFirebaseReportMonitor`)
- Headless `grok` invocations that use the dedicated skill `.grok/skills/generate-ai-opportunity-report/SKILL.md`

## Files you will see
- `input-*.json` — raw submission data written by the monitor before invoking Grok (temporary, useful for debugging)
- `prompt-*.txt` — the full prompt given to headless Grok (also temporary)
- `*-ai-opportunity-report.md` — the main deliverable (Markdown). The owner reviews and can forward or convert to the customer.
- `*.docx` (when Grok successfully uses docx generation tools) — polished Word version ready to attach/email.

## Naming
`{sanitized-email-or-id}-{timestamp}-ai-opportunity-report.md`

## Important
- Never commit real customer data to git.
- The desktop monitor writes here when it detects new Firestore entries (prod or test collection).
- You can also manually trigger generation from the monitor UI ("Simulate..." button is great for testing the Grok flow).

See the monitor's own README (`../../tools/GrokFirebaseReportMonitor/README.md`) for setup, service account, and how the headless Grok + skill combination works.
